summary: tests/unit/groupTitle.test.ts covers all 5 TDD Anchor cases 1:1 with real assertions on real return values — no mocks, no shared state, no magic data. Litmus test verified empirically, not by inspection: six mutants of resolveGroupTitle (drop fallback, drop trim, return trimmed value, always return default, trim the default, invert the condition) were each injected and each was killed by the suite, so the tests genuinely constrain the implementation. Notably the suite pins both halves of the Decision 7 boundary: 'whitespace-only counts as empty' (trim used for the emptiness check) and 'stored value returned as-is' (trim NOT applied to the result) — the exact pair a future refactor is most likely to collapse. Style matches tests/unit/statusTransitions.test.ts; Group is not imported, so the deliberate independence from task 03 holds. Suite is green (5/5). One nano-level observation, not a finding: the first assertion of 'default label is returned unmodified' exercises the same branch as 'empty stored title → default label' and kills no mutant the latter does not — but the TDD Anchor explicitly requires a non-ASCII/other-locale default case, so it stays. No test was requested or expected for normalization (Decision 7, other tasks), for a second export mode, or for rendering (task 06, environment 'node' with no DOM library).
